name: Capacitor-trip operating interface
summary: Uses stored electrical energy in a documented capacitor-trip unit to support an opening operation.
description: Uses stored electrical energy in a documented capacitor-trip unit to support an opening operation. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Charged capacitor unit” at the input and “Trip operating energy” at the output. Stored charge requires its own supervision and handling rules.
